result.rationale: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, so for user_count=100 and limit=50 it reports 3 pages when only 2 exist; showingLast (currentPage==totalPages) never becomes true on the real last page, and the next() action (offset = Math.min(offset+limit, user_count)) allows advancing to that empty page. The off-by-one mechanism is verifiable directly from the diff.

judged_text: Pagination math is off by one: totalPages = Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1 yields 3 pages for 100 users at limit 50, and next() clamps offset to Math.min(offset+limit, user_count) (e.g. 101 for user_count=101), which requests a page with zero members. For any group whose member count is an exact multiple of the limit, showingLast never becomes true and the admin can page into an empty last page; for non-multiples, the clamp lands past the last page start so the final page renders an empty member list while displaying currentPage/totalPages as valid.
